title: IGF 2026 Venue: Kenyatta International Convention Centre
content: The Government of Kenya is pleased to announce that the 21st annual meeting of the IGF will be hosted at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) in Nairobi, Kenya on 14-18 December 2026. Visit the KICC website here.
